answer: Make reputation pay convexly. Each identity's epoch reward and vote weight grow with the 1.5 power of the graded work it has built up over time. Splitting effort then loses money: 100 units of work in one identity earn 1,000, but spread over 100 fakes of 1 unit each they earn 100. A farm that lets its work wander across many shells discards nine tenths of its pay, like cracking one walnut into crumbs. Staying one long-lived identity becomes both the honest signal and the cheapest strategy.
